beats.headline: The fairground is yours!
beats.body: Starlight has been closed for twenty years. The ticket booth is open again and the carousel has a fresh coat of paint.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: I rode that carousel when I was six. Sell the tickets, fill the horses, and make it spin again.

beats.headline: Every horse is taken!
beats.body: The carousel went round to cheers from the crowd. A full ride pays for every seat, and a little extra.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Full house! Let it fill when there's a crowd. When it's quiet, pull the lever and keep the line moving.

beats.headline: Candy floss is back!
beats.body: The pink cart by the carousel is already the most popular spot in the park after the horses.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Children won't leave a fair without something sweet. Keep that cart busy.

beats.headline: The bumper cars are open!
beats.body: Six bright cars on the Midway, and the queue is already round the corner.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: The Midway's open! Launch the cars when they're full, and listen for the crashes.

beats.headline: The supply truck is here!
beats.body: It brings sugar, buns and prizes to your new shed. Carry the boxes to the stalls and they’ll never run short.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Pick up the boxes at the shed's door and take them behind the stalls. An empty stall sells nothing.

beats.headline: You’ve hired a ride operator!
beats.body: The carousel runs itself now: full loads go at once, and nobody waits too long.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: That's the park finding its feet: the rides run themselves now. Keep an eye on them, mind. That machinery is old.

beats.headline: A ride has broken down!
beats.body: It stopped with a bang and a puff of smoke. Roll up your sleeves and fix it at the lever.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: These old rides wear out. Stand at the lever with a spanner and it'll run again. A mechanic would save you the trouble.

beats.headline: The teacups are spinning!
beats.body: Four giant teacups in Kiddie Corner, and the children can’t get enough of them.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Two rides in Kiddie Corner now. One operator can run them both if they're quick on their feet.

beats.headline: The park is spotless!
beats.body: New bins line the paths and a janitor sweeps up after the crowds. A tidy park keeps everyone smiling.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: A tidy park keeps folk smiling. Now, those lights by the gate haven't been switched on in twenty years...

beats.headline: The lights are on!
beats.body: For the first time in twenty years Starlight glows after dark, and the crowds are staying past sunset.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: There it is, just like I remember. The park's at its best in the evening.

beats.headline: The sky swings are flying!
beats.body: Twelve chairs swing out over the water. Lakeside is open, and everyone’s talking about the view.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Lakeside's open. A ride that size needs its line kept moving.

beats.headline: Rex has opened MegaLand!
beats.body: It’s just across the lake, with a giant slide and free parking, and your crowds are thinner already.
beats.speaker: rival
beats.words: A fun park? Cute. MegaLand has the biggest slide in the state. Enjoy your teacups.

beats.headline: The swan boats are out!
beats.body: Four swans paddle round the lake. Couples are queueing for them, most of all in the evenings.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: The buses help with MegaLand. Fill those boats when a bus comes in.

beats.headline: A thunderstorm is here!
beats.body: The outdoor rides are closed until it passes. Everyone is piling into the haunted house and the stalls, where everything pays double.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Rides outside stop in a storm, but the haunted house runs in any weather. Everything indoors pays double till it passes.

beats.headline: Meet Starry, your mascot!
beats.body: A big smiling star is waving at the queues, and children are lining up for photos.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Send Starry to the longest line. Folk don't mind a wait with a star to wave at.

beats.headline: You’ve hired a cashier!
beats.body: Someone else collects the takings from the rides and stalls now. Your hands are free for bigger plans.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: The big rides next: a log flume, a roller coaster to beat MegaLand, and fireworks over the lake.

beats.headline: The log flume is open!
beats.body: Logs float up the lift and down into the splash pool. Riders come off soaked and go straight back to the queue.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Mind you don't stand too near the pool. The Thrill Zone's open!

beats.headline: The gift shop is open!
beats.body: Balloons, hats and plush toys for the way home, plus a shelf to show off the prizes you win at ring toss.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Everyone wants something to take home. And look at that prize shelf: win the whole set!

beats.headline: Fireworks over the lake!
beats.body: Rockets light up the sky at sunset. Crowds stay late for the show, and the rides are busier after dark.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Fireworks every evening! Folk come for the show and ride till the end. Night rides pay more.

beats.headline: MegaLand has closed!
beats.body: The Starlight Comet, with its loop and its drop over the lake, is open. Rex’s crowds came straight over the bridge.
beats.speaker: rival
beats.words: A loop-the-loop. Fine. You win this one. I hear Bay City's looking for someone with ideas...

beats.headline: The Starlight Wheel is shining!
beats.body: Lit up like a star, you can see it from all over town, and every ticket in the park is worth more for it.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: The city's been asking about you. Downtown is next. There's land for sale there, if you can raise the money.
